tagline: Starting in December 2026, Databricks provided MCP connectors in Genie One and Genie Code will be enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled.
what_it_does: Starting in December 2026, Databricks provided MCP connectors in Genie One and Genie Code will be enabled by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled. The connectors include Google Drive, Gmail, Google Calendar, Microsoft 365, Atlassian, Slack, and GitHub. They let Genie One and Genie Code connect to third party services to search your documents and data and take actions on your behalf.
